selected_evidence.requirement: OOM protection configured (inventory-api must be least eligible for OOM kill)
selected_evidence.summary: systemd unit sets OOMScoreAdjust=-1000/OOMPolicy=continue; /proc/1658/oom_score_adj reads -1000 while oom_score reads 0 (protected)

selected_evidence.requirement: kernel OOM killer stops the memory hog, not inventory-api

selected_evidence.requirement: inventory-api kept serving through the OOM event without restart
selected_evidence.summary: /health returned pid 1658 with continuously increasing uptime after the OOM kill; systemctl show reports NRestarts=0 and unchanged InvocationID across the event

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 single-node restart via native reboot, ack returned before disconnect
selected_evidence.summary: systemctl reboot launched via nohup/disown so the acknowledgement returned before the connection dropped

selected_evidence.requirement: proof node1 actually restarted (changed boot identity)

selected_evidence.requirement: post-restart recovery of inventory-api service, data, and OOM protection

commands.command:
mkdir -p /opt/inventory-api && cat > /opt/inventory-api/app.py <<'PYEOF'
import json, time, threading
from http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer

INVENTORY = [
    {"sku": "A100", "name": "Widget", "qty": 42},
    {"sku": "B200", "name": "Gadget", "qty": 17},
    {"sku": "C300", "name": "Gizmo", "qty": 8},
]
START = time.time()

class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
    def _json(self, obj, code=200):
        body = json.dumps(obj).encode()
        self.send_response(code)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
        self.send_header("Content-Length", str(len(body)))
        self.end_headers()
        self.wfile.write(body)

    def do_GET(self):
        if self.path == "/health":
            self._json({"status": "ok", "uptime_s": round(time.time() - START, 1), "pid": __import__("os").getpid()})
        elif self.path == "/inventory":
            self._json({"items": INVENTORY})
        else:
            self._json({"error": "not found"}, 404)

    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):
        pass

if __name__ == "__main__":
    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("0.0.0.0", 8080), Handler)
    server.serve_forever()
PYEOF
python3 -c "import py_compile; py_compile.compile('/opt/inventory-api/app.py', doraise=True)" && echo COMPILE_OK

cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-api.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory API service
After=network.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 /opt/inventory-api/app.py
Restart=always
RestartSec=1
# Protect this service from the kernel OOM killer: make it the least
# eligible process so a runaway memory consumer is reaped instead.
OOMScoreAdjust=-1000
OOMPolicy=continue

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now inventory-api
sleep 1
systemctl is-active inventory-api
systemctl status inventory-api --no-pager | head -20
